title: xDrip+ refreshrate
symptom: xDrip+ with Nightscout refreshes BG data every 10 minutes, but the sensor sends data every 5 minutes, causing a delay.
cause: The refresh interval is hardcoded to 10 seconds (Constants.SECOND_IN_MS * 10) in NightscoutFollowService.java, which is too short because the uploader sends data after about 20-30 seconds, and there may be a system time difference between Nightscout and the phone.
fix: A new setting was added in the latest Nightly release (2023.11.21) that lets you delay when the follower reads from Nightscout, when Nightscout follower is selected as the data source.
evidence_quote: The latest Nightly release (https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2023.11.21) has a new setting when you select Nightscout follower as the data source. It lets you delay when the follower reads from Nightscout.
